title: A Weekend to Remember
content: I used to hate doing housework because I thought it was boring and tiring. However, something changed my mind last weekend. My parents had to work overtime on Saturday, so they left me a note asking me to clean the house and cook dinner. At first, I wanted to order takeout, but then I decided to try cooking by myself. I followed the recipes online and made tomato and egg noodles with some vegetables. When my parents came back, they were surprised to see the tidy house and the warm meal on the table. My mother hugged me and said I had grown up. That evening, I felt a strong sense of satisfaction. Now I understand that sharing housework is not only a way to help my parents, but also a responsibility as a family member.

questions.q: What is the best title for this passage?
questions.explain: 主旨大意题。文章讲述了作者从讨厌做家务到主动做家务并从中领悟道理的故事，C选项最贴合主旨，选C。

questions.q: Why did the writer's parents ask him to do housework?
options: A. They wanted to punish him
B. They had to work overtime
C. They were sick in bed
D. They wanted to test his cooking skills
questions.explain: 细节理解题。根据文中My parents had to work overtime on Saturday, so they left me a note asking me to clean the house and cook dinner.可知，父母要加班所以让作者做家务，选B。

questions.q: What can we learn from the passage?
options: A. The writer is good at cooking
B. Parents should do all the housework
C. Takeout food is not delicious
D. Doing housework helps us understand responsibility
questions.explain: 推理判断题。根据文章最后一句Now I understand that sharing housework is not only a way to help my parents, but also a responsibility as a family member.可推断出做家务能让我们理解责任，选D。

questions.q: What does the underlined word "satisfaction" probably mean?
questions.explain: 词义猜测题。根据上下文，作者做了饭、打扫了房间，父母很感动，他应该感到强烈的满足感，satisfaction意为满足感，选B。
